text:
Ava (People Ops): Quick heads up — were launching a mandatory Q2 Privacy & Data Handling refresh today. Everyone (FT, PT, contractors with any data access) needs to: complete the 20-min microtraining and submit the short attestation form by EOD next Friday (7 days). Also: perform a light doc-scrub for any docs that mention real customer PII (see checklist). Training + scrub checklist: https://redwood-internal.company/training/q2-privacy :calendar:

Jamal (Security): Important note on scrubbing: replace any direct identifiers with [REDACTED], remove or hash account IDs, and add the file-level label "PII-scrubbed:v1" (or add an entry to the repo scrub_status.md if the doc is in git/monorepo). If you dont have access to the repo or the label, DM me and well grant it.

Marta (Legal): Heads-up for managers: contractors who interact with customer data must have a signed attestation. Managers — confirm your contractor list by replying to this thread so People Ops can follow up.

Leo (Eng): Quick Q: scope for the scrub? Internal Confluence pages, shared Notion, public GitHub READMEs, and any S3 objects that may contain examples?

Ava (People Ops): @Leo (Eng) yes to all of the above. Priority order: public-facing assets > shared docs > archived buckets. If youre unsure, treat it as potentially visible and scrub.

Avery (Manager): Will there be an automated scan for obvious PII (emails/SSNs)?

Jamal (Security): Were running a lightweight pattern scan across repos and S3; it catches common email/SSN/account-id patterns but its not perfect. The scan reports will land in the compliance dashboard; use them as a starting point but please do manual checks for any high-risk artifacts.

Jamal (Security): For people working in git, the recommended quick workflow:```bash
# mark repo as scrubbed
echo "PII-scrubbed:v1" >> scrub_status.md
git add scrub_status.md && git commit -m "scrub: add PII-scrubbed:v1" && git push
```

Ava (People Ops): Office hours this week to help teams: Wed 2-3pm PT & Thu 9-10am PT in #compliance-office-hours. Link: https://zoom.company/comp-hours. If you cant make it, file a ticket at https://redwood-internal.company/it-requests and tag it "compliance-scrub".

ComplianceBot: Reminder scheduled — 3 days left to complete the microtraining and upload attestations. :alarm_clock:

Leo (Eng): Thanks. Ill triage my team's shared Notion pages this afternoon and ping Jamal if anything blocked.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks all — well post a final summary after the deadline. If youre a manager and need the contractor attestation template, DM me or grab it from: https://redwood-internal.company/templates/contractor-attestation.pdf :white_check_mark:
